items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Anchor is the invoice date, Wed 18.11.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts 19.11.2026. 21 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Wed 09.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in NW (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 193 BGB), so the due date stays 09.12.2026.
